limitations: No board flashing, real power-cut tests, PWM/ESC signal-loss or mechanical tests performed.
Actual LSI bounds, watchdog timeout switching, task WCET and stack watermarks remain unmeasured.
Phase 1 has only external LoRa control. Wi-Fi takeover, S3 upgrade locks/restricted programmer and reason UI are Phase 2.
Sender not modified; it must renew within 3000ms. Do not repeatedly replay toggle events as fresh commands.
Cross-reset LoRa fresh-session/anti-delayed-air-frame contract is not implemented.
S3 immediate OTA confirmation is unchanged; end-to-end protected wireless updates are not yet delivered.
PC real LoRa sender/uplink is not implemented; local original VISION is integrated and tested with recorded input. No hardware operations performed.

pc_workstation.native_bridge_contracts: attach without download; pause/inspection; exact factory plan; deny propagated without retry or fallback
limitations: PC LoRa sender and telemetry uplink not integrated.
Full source and waveform panels require the installed VS Code EmberProbe host.
No physical programming or debugging acceptance performed.
